title: inventory.reservation.released — Payload Schema
description: Emitted by erp.inventory when a reservation is manually released before its TTL. Triggers: explicit order cancellation by the buyer, cancellation by an operator, or a payment failure that warrants immediate release rather than waiting for TTL. The released units are returned to aggregate_available. erp.inventory also emits a corresponding inventory.stock.updated message.

reservation_id.description: Identifier of the reservation being released.

order_id.description: Identifier of the Commerce order associated with this reservation.

product_id.description: Stable product identifier from ERP Core.

location_id.description: Location from which the units are released back to available.

quantity.description: Number of units returned to aggregate_available.

release_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for the manual release. buyer_cancelled: the buyer explicitly cancelled the order. operator_cancelled: a warehouse or support operator cancelled the reservation. payment_failed: the payment processor returned a definitive failure, warranting immediate release.

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the release was committed in ERP Core.
